<a id="legend"></a>

**Legend:** <img src="badges/current.svg" alt="current" title="Current" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Current · <img src="badges/outdated.svg" alt="outdated" title="Outdated" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Outdated · <img src="badges/skipped.svg" alt="skipped" title="Skipped" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Skipped · <img src="badges/running.svg" alt="running" title="Running" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Running · <img src="badges/publishing.svg" alt="publishing" title="Publishing" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Publishing · <img src="badges/failed.svg" alt="failed" title="Failed" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Failed · <img src="badges/pending.svg" alt="pending" title="Pending" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Pending · <img src="badges/superseded.svg" alt="superseded" title="Superseded" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Superseded · <img src="badges/not-built.svg" alt="not built" title="Not built" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Not&nbsp;built · <img src="badges/cancelled.svg" alt="cancelled" title="Cancelled" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Cancelled.

The green check marks Current: the available package matches Latest release. The brown clock marks Outdated: an older or different available version. Completed publication appears as `—` in In build because no replacement remains in progress. Pending waits for a build; Superseded was replaced by a newer release or attempt; Not built has no recorded build. Filled indicators mean a package exists or work is happening; rings mean nothing yet or stopped. The filled Failed cross records a failed attempt, not package availability. Alternative text and hover titles name every state. `—` means no available package, no replacement in progress, or an unrecorded fact, according to the column. A waiting dependent's Build log may open its prerequisite release run before a child build job exists.
